title: DisasterSurvival
description: Survive over 20 unique natural disasters in singleplayer or multiplayer. Random disasters, generated maps, loot, and intense survival gameplay.
body:
Disaster Survival

Survive devastating natural disasters in Minecraft! Fight against earthquakes, tornadoes, floods, volcanoes, meteors, and many more while trying to stay alive until the disaster ends.

Designed for both singleplayer and multiplayer, Disaster Survival turns every round into a unique survival challenge.

Features

🌪️ 20+ unique disasters

Tornado
Earthquake
Flood
Tsunami
Hurricane
Storm
Blizzard
Hailstorm
Sandstorm
Wildfire
Volcano
Meteor
Avalanche
Landslide
Ice Storm
Heatwave
Extreme Cold
Drought
Monsoon
El Niño

Every disaster has its own behavior and survival challenge.

🏝️ Random maps

Each game takes place on a generated survival map with structures and loot to help players survive.

🎮 Multiple game modes

Singleplayer
Multiplayer
Lobby system
Game states
Round management
Voting system

📦 Loot & exploration

Search structures and chests for useful resources before disaster strikes.

⚡ Optimized gameplay

Automatic disaster management
Built-in lobby system
Configurable game lengths
Smooth multiplayer support
Gameplay
Join a game.
Gather supplies.
A random disaster begins.
Adapt to the environment.
Survive until the timer ends.

Every round is different thanks to the variety of disasters and randomized gameplay.

Requirements
Fabric Loader
Fabric API
Minecraft 1.21.1
Java 21
Multiplayer and Singleplayer

Disaster Survival fully supports multiplayer, allowing friends to compete or cooperate while surviving increasingly dangerous disasters.
